title: Veggie Surprises! Potato, Mushrooms and More with Kiko
intro: Hi, friends! I'm Pip the strawberry, and this is my buddy Kiko the broccoli!
Welcome to Fruity Friends! Today we're meeting five veggie surprises, and some of them hide underground!
Can you count with me? One, two, three, four, five!
Yummy food and healthy habits help us grow, play and learn every day.
Ready? Let's go to the kitchen and find out!

lines: Here's a clue: it's brown and lumpy, and it grows hiding under the ground! Can you guess?
This is Potato! Can you say potato?
Potatoes grow under the ground. Only the green leaves poke out on top.
Potatoes can be brown, red, yellow or even purple!
Can you dig for potatoes? Dig, dig, dig, and pull one up!
No! We cook them first. They can be mashed, baked or roasted.
One more time, nice and loud: POTATO!
The little dots on a potato are called eyes. A new plant can grow from them!
Here's a clue: it's long and reddish outside, and bright orange inside! Can you guess?
This is Sweet Potato! Can you say sweet potato?
Sweet potatoes grow under the ground, like potatoes do.
Most sweet potatoes are orange inside. Some are purple or white!
Can you stretch out long, like a sweet potato? Long, long, long!
Why is it called a sweet potato?
Because it tastes a little sweet when it's cooked!
Let's say it together: SWEET POTATO!
One more time, nice and loud: SWEET POTATO!
Sweet potatoes are cooked before we eat them, soft and warm.
Here's a clue: it has a round cap on top, like a little umbrella! Can you guess?
These are mushrooms! Can you say mushroom?
Mushrooms are not plants! They're a fungus. That's a fun word: fungus!
Mushrooms grow in cool, shady places. They don't grow from seeds.
Can you make a mushroom? Stand up tall, and hold your arms round like a cap!
Where do we get mushrooms to eat?
From the store, or from a grown-up! We never pick wild ones to eat.
One more time, nice and loud: MUSHROOM!
Mushrooms can be white, brown, big or tiny, and grown-ups cook them in yummy meals.
Here's a clue: it's orange and crunchy, and it grows under the ground! Can you guess?
This is Carrot! Can you say carrot?
Carrots grow down in the dirt. The green leaves stay on top.
A carrot is a root. It pulls up water from the ground for the plant.
Can you pull a carrot out of the ground? Pull, pull, POP!
No! Some carrots are purple, yellow or white.
One more time, nice and loud: CARROT!
Carrots are crunchy raw, and soft and sweet when they're cooked.
Here's a clue: they're little green balls that live in a pod! Can you guess?
This is Peas! Can you say peas?
Peas grow on climbing vines, inside a long green pod.
Each pea is really a seed! Plant one, and a new pea plant can grow.
Can you count peas in a pod with me? One, two, three, four, five!
Inside a pod! All in a row, like a cozy bed.
One more time, nice and loud: PEAS!
Peas are sweet and green, and fun to count on your plate.

recap: Yummy! Let's remember what we learned.
And peas, little seeds in a pod!
outro: Which one was your favorite? Tell a grown-up, and try something new this week!
Bye, friends! See you next time on Fruity Friends!
